docs.text:
Gaṅgānātha Jhā's English translation of the Yoga-sūtras with Vyāsa's commentary and notes from Vācaspati Miśra, Vijñānabhikṣu and Bhoja (Bombay, 1907).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by Google from a copy of the Harvard College Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Yoga-darśana: The Sutras of Patañjali with the Bhāsya of Vyasa · Patañjali · 1907, 187 scanned pages. Published 1907; Ganganatha Jha died 1941; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
